output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # grids consist of 5x5 tiles separated by lines of 3s
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    starts_r=[0]+[i+1 for i in range(H) if all(x==3 for x in grid[i])]
    starts_c=[0]+[j+1 for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(H))]
    starts_r=[x for x in starts_r if x<H]
    starts_c=[x for x in starts_c if x<W]
    tiles=[]
    for r in starts_r:
        for c in starts_c:
            tiles.append([[grid[r+i][c+j] for j in range(5)] for i in range(5)])
    # modal value at each tile cell gives undamaged template
    base=[]
    for i in range(5):
        row=[]
        for j in range(5):
            vals=[t[i][j] for t in tiles]
            row.append(max(set(vals),key=vals.count))
        base.append(row)
    # choose tile with deviations; encode deviations as 1
    t=max(tiles,key=lambda z:sum(z[i][j]!=base[i][j] for i in range(5) for j in range(5)))
    return [[1 if t[i][j]!=base[i][j] else t[i][j] for j in range(5)] for i in range(5)]"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # locate separator rows/columns (uniform 3 lines)
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sr=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==3 for x in r)]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(H))]
    rb=[0]+[x+1 for x in sr]; re=sr+[H]
    cb=[0]+[x+1 for x in sc]; ce=sc+[W]
    tiles=[]
    for a,b in zip(rb,re):
      for c,d in zip(cb,ce): tiles.append([row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]])
    # modal tile
    from collections import Counter
    def key(t): return tuple(tuple(r) for r in t)
    base=Counter(key(t) for t in tiles).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # select tile with greatest difference from modal (usually unique corruption)
    t=max(tiles,key=lambda z:sum(x!=y for r,s in zip(z,base) for x,y in zip(r,s)))
    out=[]
    for r,s in zip(t,base): out.append([1 if x!=y else x for x,y in zip(r,s)])
    return out"}
